neighbours.label: a negated modal or 'never' that denies possibility, strongest in emphatic praise idioms ('cannot be overstated', 'could not be easier', 'can't be beat', 'never ceases to'); the same praise stated without negation stays quiet
fire: For a new gardener, the value of good soil simply cannot be overstated.
Once you try this method, folding laundry could not be simpler.
For the price, this little camera really can't be beaten.
Watching the tide come in, it never ceases to delight me.
Frankly, the role of the coach in this win cannot be exaggerated.
With a slow cooker, the stew couldn't be any easier to prepare.
Ask anyone in town: their fresh bagels can't be topped.
As a teacher, it never stops surprising me how kind students are.
quiet: For a new gardener, the value of good soil is very high indeed.
Once you try this method, folding laundry becomes quite simple.
For the price, this little camera is a really good deal.
Watching the tide come in, I always feel delighted by it.
Frankly, the role of the coach in this win was very large.
With a slow cooker, the stew is very easy to prepare.
Ask anyone in town: their fresh bagels are the best around.
As a teacher, I am often surprised by how kind students are.
